missing_entity.title: {name}: missing entities
missing_entity.description:
The notification **{name}** uses entities that do not exist: {entities}. Its triggers and conditions that use them do not work. Change the notification in Notification Center, or bring the entities back.

[Open in Notification Center]({link})

invalid_every.title: {name}: the schedule is stopped
invalid_every.description:
Step {step} of **{name}** takes its interval from {entity}, but its state is not a number, so the schedule is stopped, as with 0. It starts again when the state is a number.

[Open in Notification Center]({link})

template_error.title: {name}: error in the message
template_error.description:
The message or the info line of step {step} of **{name}** has a template error, so the notification shows the text without the template: {error}

[Open in Notification Center]({link})

setup_error.title: {name}: a trigger or condition does not work
setup_error.description:
Step {step} of **{name}** could not be set up: {error}

[Open in Notification Center]({link})

missing_push_service.title: {name}: the push device is missing
missing_push_service.description:
The push notifications of **{name}** go to {service}, but there is no such action. Choose the phone again on the People page of Notification Center, or bring the action back.

[Open in Notification Center]({link})

missing_device.title: {kind} {entity} is missing
missing_device.description:
The {kind} channel uses {entity}, but there is no such entity, so the channel does nothing. Choose the entity again in Notification Center, or bring it back.

[Open in Notification Center]({link})
